decoder: frozen dynamic-append-v1 with exact incremental decoder; no evaluation cache bypass
matching: Identical first 100 evaluated four vectors. Every 5000 global FE, 100 local visits with matched preference, factory, per-round paid quotas; repeat a naturally exhausted pass until its quota is used.
nsga: Original 4V variation and NSGA-II selection; local preference slots only, no persistent families or sharing. At each block retain NSGA-II selection from the union of pre-local survivors and local results.
scope: Single instance and seed, schedule frozen from deep SHARE allocation replay. Comparison of algorithm packages, not a separate causal contrast for four swarms. Record wall time, not a wall-time-controlled race.
